sources.title: Aleatorik Operation 1 | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: The Effects Database catalogs Aleatorik Operation 1 as an overdrive pedal and identifies it as one of the Aleatorik Operation models.

sources.title: レア ALEATORIK Operation 1 プロトタイプ HUMANGEAR ヒューマンギア 寺田仁の落札情報詳細
sources.h1: ALEATORIK Operation 1 プロトタイプ
sources.excerpt: The listing identifies the item as an ALEATORIK Operation 1 prototype and describes maker Jin Terada as a very busy recording engineer, with production limited to roughly 15 units per month.

sources.title: ALEATORIK Operation 1 ＆ 2 & 3 & 4
sources.excerpt: The historical Japanese page identifies the ALEATORIK Operation 1-4 series and notes that the pedals were not always easy to obtain because maker Terada Jin was a very busy recording engineer.

sources.title: Aleatorik | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: The Aleatorik brand reference describes Operation 1-4 as fully hand-built with three-dimensional wiring, no PCBs, and no soldering at component terminals.
